decks.notes: This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing counterspells, card draw, and board wipes to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It aims to maintain card advantage through Narset, Parter of Veils and Memory Deluge, while locking down the board with Supreme Verdict and Temporary Lockdown. Field of Ruin and Fountainport provide additional disruption by targeting the opponent's lands. The deck also includes a few win conditions such as The Wandering Emperor and March of Otherworldly Light, allowing it to close out the game once it has stabilized and gained control.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble the combo of Lotus Field and various untapping effects to generate a large amount of mana quickly. The deck utilizes cards like Hidden Strings, Vizier of Tumbling Sands, and Pore Over the Pages to untap Lotus Field multiple times in a turn. This enables the player to cast powerful spells like Dig Through Time, Aetherflux Reservoir, and Fae of Wishes to win the game or control the board. The deck also includes card draw and selection, mana fixing, and versatile removal options to support the combo strategy.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent and win the game before they can establish a strong defense. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds another dimension to the deck's strategy. With a mix of removal spells like Reckless Rage and Fatal Push, as well as powerful creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Kumano Faces Kakkazan, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient threats. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive game plan while providing consistent access to the necessary colors of mana.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on utilizing fast and aggressive creatures along with burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent and control the board. The key strategy is to apply pressure early on and maintain a steady stream of damage to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize. With cards like Slickshot Show-Off, Monastery Swiftspear, and Heartfire Hero, the deck aims to win the game quickly and efficiently. Additionally, the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides added flexibility and potential for a strong late-game presence.

This deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to tutor for powerful creatures, while also controlling the board with removal spells and disruptive cards. The key strategy is to establish a strong board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Portable Hole and Skyclave Apparition. By using Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Yorion, Sky Nomad as companions, the deck aims to generate value and outvalue the opponent in the late game. Additionally, the deck includes a variety of lands to ensure consistent mana fixing and access to all the necessary colors for its spells.

This deck focuses on using Enigmatic Incarnation to constantly tutor for powerful creatures and enchantments, controlling the board while setting up a strong late game. The inclusion of a companion, Yorion, Sky Nomad, allows for additional flexibility and card advantage. The deck runs a variety of removal spells, mana fixing lands, and powerful threats like Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The goal is to outvalue the opponent by generating consistent advantage through Enigmatic Incarnation and overwhelming them with powerful threats.

The deck revolves around utilizing Lotus Field's mana generation to cast powerful spells that can win the game in a single turn. By combining cards like Archdruid's Charm, Hidden Strings, and Pore Over the Pages with the land Lotus Field, the player can quickly ramp up their mana and cast game-changing spells such as Omniscience and Peer into the Abyss. The deck also includes protective cards like Strict Proctor and Bala Ged Recovery to ensure the combo is successful. Overall, the strategy focuses on quickly assembling the combo pieces and overwhelming the opponent with a massive play.

The main focus of this deck is to control the battlefield through a combination of discard spells, removal spells, and powerful creatures. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by stripping their hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also having access to removal spells like Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict to deal with threats. The deck also utilizes powerful creatures like Archfiend of the Dross and Liliana of the Veil to close out the game. Additionally, the deck plays lands that provide utility such as Mutavault and Field of Ruin.

The main idea behind this deck is to use Transmogrify to turn a creature into a powerful threat, such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier or Urabrask's Forge, to quickly close out the game. The deck also includes various disruption spells like Fatal Push and Thoughseize to control the board and protect the combo. Additionally, the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with small, aggressive creatures and burn spells. It aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total while controlling the board with removal spells like Fatal Push. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional value and consistency to the deck. With cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Kumano Faces Kakkazan, the deck can push for damage early on and close out the game with cards like Heartfire Hero and Emberheart Challenger. The focus is on a fast, proactive game plan to secure victory.

This deck aims to assemble a powerful combo involving Lotus Field and Hidden Strings to generate large amounts of mana and card advantage. By carefully setting up the right pieces and utilizing cards like Thespian's Stage and Vizier of Tumbling Sands, the deck can quickly ramp up to play big spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience. The inclusion of cards like Dark Petition and Bala Ged Recovery provides additional utility and flexibility to the deck, allowing for a variety of lines of play to outmaneuver opponents.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up your graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and deal a lot of damage to your opponent. Using spells like Consider, Opt, and Treasure Cruise to draw cards and dump cards into the graveyard, while also using Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe for removal. Artist's Talent and Ledger Shredder help you dig through your deck faster, and Picklock Prankster adds another way to bring back Arclight Phoenix. The deck aims to be very aggressive and put pressure on the opponent early on.

This deck focuses on quickly sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar to trigger abilities that deal damage to the opponent, such as Mayhem Devil. It also utilizes cards like Deadly Dispute and Claim the Firstborn to take advantage of sacrificing creatures for value. The deck aims to apply pressure early with aggressive creatures and removal spells like Fatal Push, while also maintaining a strong board presence with cards like Witch's Oven. The mana base includes various dual lands to ensure a smooth curve and consistent access to the necessary colors of mana.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to apply aggressive pressure on the opponent using powerful creatures like Archfiend of the Dross and Bloodtithe Harvester, supported by removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board. The deck also utilizes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Blade of the Oni to disrupt the opponent's strategy and maintain momentum. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Unholy Annex / Ritual Chamber and Bitter Triumph to generate additional value and resilience. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and relentless assault.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with low-cost creatures and pump spells, utilizing the aggressive strategy of the Rakdos color combination. The deck focuses on dealing damage quickly and efficiently, utilizing cards like Emberheart Challenger, Monastery Swiftspear, and Heartfire Hero to apply pressure early on. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion provides additional flexibility and consistency to the deck, allowing for a strong aggressive game plan while maintaining a solid mana base. The deck aims to close out games swiftly through a combination of creature aggression and direct damage spells.

The deck focuses on using Transmogrify to combo with Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, allowing you to cheat powerful creatures into play from your deck. The deck also includes a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Torching the Tower, as well as disruption and card draw with spells like Thoughtseize, Duress, and Courier's Briefcase. The inclusion of Atraxa, Grand Unifier and other powerful creatures helps to ensure that you have a strong board presence and can close out the game quickly.
